Question: ek larki jo balik hai aur shadi ke layak bhi par woh nikah karna nahi chati.aur uske walden agar haj karna chate hai ya haj k liye jaye to unka haj ho jayega ya nahi. larki ka nikah karne se pehle. Answer ID: 15586 Posted on: Aug 28, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1372/1372=M=1430) If hajj is obligatory on parents and they have security means for their daughter too, they should first perform hajj, their hajj will be valid. Hajj should not be delayed due to marriage. Yes, it is better if it is possible to solemnize nikah according to sunnah without causing delay in performing hajj. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
